name: UltraSearch Pro CrossPlatform
request: Recreate UltraSearch Pro - a fast file search application for Windows. Build a cross-platform version that works on both Windows and Linux with the same core features: fast file indexing, search syntax, and file preview.
note: Building UltraSearch Pro clone with cross-platform support (Windows + Linux) using Rust + egui/eframe. Goal: fast file search application with indexing and search syntax.
